description: This file implements a web search provider plugin for Kimi by Moonshot, including configuration resolution, search execution, and setup functions.

methods.name: resolveKimiConfig
methods.description: Resolves the Kimi configuration from the search config.

methods.name: resolveKimiApiKey
methods.description: Retrieves the API key for Kimi from secrets or environment variables.

methods.name: resolveKimiModel
methods.description: Determines the search model to use, defaulting if unspecified.

methods.name: trimTrailingSlashes
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from a URL.

methods.name: resolveKimiBaseUrl
methods.description: Determines the base URL for Kimi API, considering explicit config, Moonshot config, or default.

methods.name: extractKimiMessageText
methods.description: Extracts the main text content from a Kimi message.

methods.name: extractKimiCitations
methods.description: Extracts URLs as citations from Kimi search response data.

methods.name: extractKimiToolResultContent
methods.description: Extracts the content of a tool call from Kimi response.

methods.name: runKimiSearch
methods.description: Performs the search by calling Kimi API, handling retries and citations.

methods.name: createKimiSchema
methods.description: Creates a JSON schema for Kimi search parameters.

methods.name: createKimiToolDefinition
methods.description: Creates the web search tool definition for Kimi, including execution logic.

methods.name: runKimiSearchProviderSetup
methods.description: Handles setup for the Kimi web search provider, including region and model selection.

methods.name: createKimiWebSearchProvider
methods.description: Exports the plugin object for Kimi web search provider.
